selection.rationale: Measured facts. (1) Objective split: ORIGINAL baseline end_to_end_ms 690.12 with ttft_ms 24.05 and decode_ms 666.12 (inputs/project.json), so 96.5% of the objective is the 31 decode steps at decode-phase Qwen3ForCausalLM call 323bcbe006b343648b346af9 (group 3e293c00b1fb98fbe29f, 374.18 ms inclusive diagnostic CUDA), while the ttft_ms constraint at <=1.05x fresh ORIGINAL TTFT is decided entirely in the prefill span at prefill-phase Qwen3ForCausalLM call 900c23e99c808d2c9bda215a (group e0861b46dbeeb562f67f, 21.57 ms diagnostic CUDA; adapter _infer inputs/adapter.py:32-38). Decode is host-dispatch bound: execution_timeline (inputs/observations/current/execution_timeline-1221e205.json) measured a 1441.75 ms profiled window with 386.81 ms kernel-active union and 1054.37 ms gaps; python_runtime counted 17,472 module _wrapped_call_impl over 32 forwards (~546 per forward) inside a 908.83 ms profiled wall. (2) Two-round candidate history at exactly this boundary. The decode-only CUDA-graph candidate passed full quality bitwise (max_abs_error 0.0 over 4,861,988 elements, exact greedy tokens, teacher-forced replay exact) and cut decode_ms 666.12->368.41 and end_to_end_ms 690.12->395.01, but was rejected solely for the ttft constraint: 26.51/25.92 vs limit 25.2536 (=1.05x24.051052), a systematic +2.0-2.5 ms span regression with the parent prefill untouched; its mechanism (allocator layout vs clock state) stays an explicit unknown, and nothing inside the decode boundary lies inside the ttft span, which ends at the first-token synchronize. (3) The repair candidate (trial-a254520daa, inputs/previous-candidate/candidate.py, joint prefill+decode graphs at these same two calls) installed and replayed correctly: candidate_diagnostics (inputs/observations/previous-after/candidate_diagnostics-4123e6d6.json) records prefill_graph_replay x2 and graph_replay x62 with zero fallbacks and a passed run - but that is exactly two measure-mode generations (2x32 calls) and never exercises the quality-mode teacher-forced replay. The parameter screening run then failed at the FIRST observe: AssertionError 'teacher-forced replay token sequence differs from greedy run' (opop_adapter.py:156 via evaluation.py:386, rank_failed, empty metrics), which is the decision's no_valid_parameter_candidate; the joint candidate has no clean end_to_end/ttft measurement at all. Measured contrast: the decode-only candidate passed this same relational check with the same per-step-verified decode graphs, so the divergence is tied to the new joint elements - prefill graph, shared K/V masters, view-mirror cache, cross-invocation _mirror/_step state - on a second generation over already-used state, not to the decode graph machinery; the exact divergence site stays an explicit unknown (resources.json marks numerics.first_divergence_site unavailable, and the diagnostics trace shows no exception or fallback route). (4) Scope: the two edits need one another - decode replays read masters[0:prompt_len] that the prefill boundary must own and rewrite per invocation, one state-ownership protocol, one bundle - a joint candidate at the two phase call boundaries of the one physical Qwen3ForCausalLM module, with legacy direct-callable module boundaries and no functional dispatch. affected_calls is the union of both module subtrees (prefill root + 3,641 descendants, decode root + 23,225 descendants, disjoint, 26,868 total), recomputed from inputs/calls.json parents and equal to the prior accepted-structure selection at this boundary.
selection.hypothesis: Repair the only failure of the joint candidate - the teacher-forced replay divergence - while keeping both measured wins available: the quality-proven per-cache-length decode graphs (decode_ms 666.12->368.41 measured, bitwise quality) and prefill-span ownership that removes the eager host dispatch (~2.4 ms over 21.57 ms prefill CUDA busy) from the ttft window. Three coupled changes, tested by the framework's fresh measurement: (a) stateless per-generation step resolution - derive each decode step index from the observed past_key_values itself (mirror view length / get_seq_length on the passed cache) instead of the mutable cross-invocation _mirror/_step identity chain, so greedy run, teacher-forced replay and continuous step 2 each re-derive step 1 from cache length and cannot inherit or alias a previous generation's step state; (b) build-time relational verification of the exact failing sequence - after the existing per-step bitwise checks, execute at installation the installed sequence end-to-end (prefill replay + 31 decode replays, then a SECOND prefill replay over the used masters plus a teacher-forced decode chain), bitwise comparing logits, every layer's K/V and regenerated tokens against eager parent references; any mismatch permanently disables graphs to the proven parent fallback BEFORE measurement, converting a runtime assert into lost speedup, never silent numerics; (c) de-risk the shared-pool unknown - capture the prefill graph in its own memory pool (or capture it first) so its pool intermediates cannot alias decode-graph blocks, and keep the verified decode graphs' pool private. Expected effects, as hypotheses to be tested: ttft_ms drops from the observed 26.5 ms failure to ~22-24 ms (reclaiming the eager span's host overhead; even a ~10% post-replay kernel slowdown leaves ~23.8-24.5 ms) against the 1.05x fresh original limit, end_to_end_ms stays ~391-395 ms (decode_ms ~368.4 as measured with the same graphs; small extra gain from dropping the first-step master refresh copies), and full logits/exact-token quality passes including teacher_forced_replay_exact_tokens through graph_replay routes at both boundaries. Testable predictions: (i) quality-mode continuous steps complete with the relational replay exact; (ii) fresh evaluator ttft median <= 1.05x fresh original across repeats; (iii) if build-time relational verification fails, the bundle falls back to the parent at the affected boundary, reproducing safe-parent timing and falsifying the repair without corrupting quality. Risks kept explicit: the true divergence mechanism (state-chain aliasing vs pool interaction vs capture-time mask path) is unproven and (a)-(c) attack all three observed candidate mechanisms; the earlier +2.0-2.5 ms ttft regression mechanism also stays unknown, but owning the prefill span addresses both of its candidate mechanisms by replaying the span.
